forest-green.$description: Forest Green — Primary brand color for calls to action, text, and critical icons — grounding the UI with a sense of growth and reliability

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Background for page surfaces and pristine component backdrops, providing a clean, bright foundation

mint-glaze.$description: Mint Glaze — Soft background for informational cards and sections, introducing a gentle, almost pastel tint to the UI planes

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Cool, muted background for secondary cards and sections, offering visual separation without overwhelming the primary content

keylime-wash.$description: Keylime Wash — Lightest green surface, used for subtle card backgrounds or layered elements, providing a hint of color

mint-kiss.$description: Mint Kiss — Another very light green surface, subtly differentiating stacked cards or sections

border-grey.$description: Border Grey — Default boundary and separator color, used for hairline borders and inactive states, maintaining visual separation with minimal distraction

ink-text.$description: Ink Text — Primary text color for navigation and core content, providing strong contrast against light backgrounds

dark-charcoal.$description: Dark Charcoal — Secondary text and link color for less prominent information, like image captions or muted links

suisseintl.$description: The workhorse sans-serif for most body text, links, buttons, and detailed interface elements. Its refined simplicity supports a clinical tone without feeling sterile.

faire-octave.$description: Used exclusively for large, impactful headings. Its light weight (300) for such prominent sizes creates an authoritative yet approachable voice, suggesting wisdom through understatement rather than volume.
